prompt: Create one original production-ready Minecraft-style texture atlas for seven newly designed fictional low-poly game weapons. This is a FLAT UV MATERIAL ATLAS, not a picture of guns and not a 3D render. Square canvas, opaque full-bleed image, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square material tiles with perfectly aligned grid boundaries. No padding, no gutters, no labels, no lettering, no logos, no symbols, no weapon silhouettes. Each tile is a seamless, subtle pixel-art surface texture with hard square pixels, limited colors, even front lighting and no perspective; simple enough to downsample with nearest-neighbor to a 64x64 atlas. The original palette is dark graphite, muted cold steel, weathered copper and restrained cyan echo-crystal light, suitable for TeamLifeBind. Distinct matte versus brushed surfaces but no photoreal grain. Exact row-major tile contents: Row 1: (1) very dark gunmetal graphite, (2) softly brushed cool gray steel, (3) warm weathered copper metal, (4) cyan luminous crystal surface. Row 2: (5) matte charcoal polymer, (6) desaturated olive armor paint, (7) muted red warning paint with NO icon, (8) matte ivory ceramic. Row 3: (9) dark ribbed grip surface with simple block grooves, (10) medium burnished copper bolt surface, (11) deep blue-green optical glass with small subtle highlight, (12) muted brass metal tip surface. Row 4: (13) dark heat grille material with tiny square slots, (14) near-black rubber stock-pad material, (15) deep black muzzle metal, (16) cyan-blue echo core crystal with tiny geometric pixel light facets. Preserve all 16 distinct square tiles. Texture surfaces should be original generic materials, with no elements copied from an existing game or gun mod. Background is fully opaque.
normalization: Mechanical nearest-neighbor export preserving original pixel colors and alpha, no creative redraw
